title: A Favor for Herschel, Part 2
description: A Favor for Herschel, Part 2 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Herschel the Hitter

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Bring Babyface Buster's package to Herschel the Hitter in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Herschel the Hitter

Repeatable: No

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Bring Babyface Buster's package to Herschel the Hitter in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Quickly, let's make the swap! You brought me Herschel's box, so now I will give you this package in exchange.

You should get back to Herschel as quickly as you can. And don't tell anyone about our meeting here!

Turn-in:

Welcome back! You have something for Old Herschel? Ah, my package! And, in return, Old Herschel gives you something in return. *Wink!*

Objectives:

  • Babyface Buster's Package ×1

Level range: 84–100
